seed_expert_discoveries.technical_takeaway: If you can distill models, you can also distill agent harnesses, enabling efficient replication of complex agent behaviors from closed-source systems like Devin.

LangSmith traces serve as short-term memory while OpenWiki organizes them into long-term 'dreaming' memory for codebases; new LLM Gateway adds cost controls, rate limiting, PII redaction, and OSS model access for agents.
Recursively self-improving AI workflows using multiple LLMs (DeepSeek Flash to Fable 5) that automate tasks like bug fixing and ad optimization without human intervention, becoming smarter over time.
Upcoming GLM 5.5 as a faster/cheaper Kimi K3-class model; frontier models delayed by regulations allowing open-source to catch up.
